title: Opaque embedding: a receipt inside another receipt's content; the inner verdict is unchanged
registered_case: BAND0-EXIT E10 'the P7 verdict-independence case' (partial: see choices)
scenario: The outer receipt's content holds the exact bytes of an inner container (base64). The outer verifies VALID_STRICT whatever the inner is; the decoded inner bytes are byte-identical and keep their standalone verdict.
base: honest bundle (A-a) as outer, issued with chosen content
choices: A6.1 asks for every P4 verdict value; VALID_DEGRADED does not exist in V1, so three values.
V1 has no wrapper type (two layers are OUT_OF_PROFILE). 'Wrapper' is read as opaque content; the outer asserts nothing about the inner.
A9 row 26 moved P7's wrapper half and its H1a vector to 'Wrapping and renewal'; this is a V1 analogue, not the registered vector.

needs: Submit the content to the AWS issuer (ordinary client request); verify outer and decoded inners.
